understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level while avoiding spike tiles, completing all levels to win. Each level allows 2 attempts with up to 50 turns per attempt.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT changed the player's horizontal position, sometimes causing gravity to drop the player several tiles. Gravity was currently DOWN and automatically moved the player downward after horizontal movement. CLICK targeted a tile and could remove clickable tiles without moving the player. Landing on a spike would end the attempt and restart the level. The recent actions showed that movement can be affected by the level layout and gravity; no undo action was observed.
